name: Robot Simulator
instructions:
# Instructions

Write a robot simulator.

A robot factory's test facility needs a program to verify robot movements.

The robots have three possible movements:

- turn right
- turn left
- advance

Robots are placed on a hypothetical infinite grid, facing a particular direction (north, east, south, or west) at a set of {x,y} coordinates,
e.g., {3,8}, with coordinates increasing to the north and east.

The robot then receives a number of instructions, at which point the testing facility verifies the robot's new position, and in which direction it is pointing.

- The letter-string "RAALAL" means:
  - Turn right
  - Advance twice
  - Turn left
  - Advance once
  - Turn left yet again
- Say a robot starts at {7, 3} facing north.
  Then running this stream of instructions should leave it at {9, 4} facing west.

example_solution:
!YS-v0

dirs =: qw(north east south west)
next =: dirs.zipmap(dirs:cycle:rest)

dir =::
  north :: \(update _ 'y' inc)
  east  :: \(update _ 'x' inc)
  south :: \(update _ 'y' dec)
  west  :: \(update _ 'x' dec)

defn create(position direction): +
  {'position' position 'direction' direction}

defn move(position direction instructions):
  reduce _ create(position direction) instructions:
    fn(robot command):
      case command:
        \\A: update(robot 'position'  dir(robot.direction))
        \\R: update(robot 'direction' next)
        \\L: update(robot 'direction' set/map-invert(next))
test_code:
#!/usr/bin/env ys-0

use ys::taptest: :all
load: 'robot-simulator.ys'

test::
- name: At origin facing north
  code: create({"x" 0, "y" 0} "north")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: north

- name: At negative position facing south
  code: create({"x" -1, "y" -1} "south")
  want:
    position:
      x: -1
      y: -1
    direction: south

- name: Changes north to east
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "north" "R")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: east

- name: Changes east to south
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "east" "R")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: south

- name: Changes south to west
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "south" "R")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: west

- name: Changes west to north
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "west" "R")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: north

- name: Changes north to west
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "north" "L")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: west

- name: Changes west to south
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "west" "L")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: south

- name: Changes south to east
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "south" "L")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: east

- name: Changes east to north
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "east" "L")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 0
    direction: north

- name: Facing north increments y
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "north" "A")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: 1
    direction: north

- name: Facing south decrements y
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "south" "A")
  want:
    position:
      x: 0
      y: -1
    direction: south

- name: Facing east increments x
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "east" "A")
  want:
    position:
      x: 1
      y: 0
    direction: east

- name: Facing west decrements x
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "west" "A")
  want:
    position:
      x: -1
      y: 0
    direction: west

- name: Moving east and north from readme
  code: move({"x" 7, "y" 3} "north" "RAALAL")
  want:
    position:
      x: 9
      y: 4
    direction: west

- name: Moving west and north
  code: move({"x" 0, "y" 0} "north" "LAAARALA")
  want:
    position:
      x: -4
      y: 1
    direction: west

- name: Moving west and south
  code: move({"x" 2, "y" -7} "east" "RRAAAAALA")
  want:
    position:
      x: -3
      y: -8
    direction: south

- name: Moving east and north
  code: move({"x" 8, "y" 4} "south" "LAAARRRALLLL")
  want:
    position:
      x: 11
      y: 5
    direction: north
